show_hn.title: Show HN: Friendly AI – Chatbot messenger for your AI assistants

quotes.text:
My buddy and I have been working on a chatbot service that connects to servers running AI assistants. Friendly AI allows developers and researchers to connect their existing Python servers using a messenger interface.

We have also built a simple open source messaging protocol called BaseBot (https://github.com/sergeybok/BaseBot) that allows anyone to add support for our app to their existing servers. Users can create a server running a LLM bot, Stable Diffusion bot, or any other server application. Check out the experimental quickstart section to get up and running on your own device: https://github.com/sergeybok/BaseBot#experimental-quickstart.

Right now, the app is built using React Native, but we are actively working on native apps for both iOS and Android with expanded functionality. While the Android app is still in review, you can check out the iOS app at: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/friendly-ai/id6447589849.

If you have any questions or would like to share any feedback privately, you can email us at contact@friendlyai.xyz.
